claim: There is one patient and no retained diagnostic target or outcome table.
prior_art: Established identifiability and validation prerequisites, not a novel law
falsification: Add patient-level pathology/outcome labels, a sufficient independent cohort, and a frozen endpoint/validation protocol.

claim: All 70 MR instances share one echo time; slice variation cannot replace repeated echoes of the same tissue. A and T2 are not separately identifiable.
equation: S(TE)=A exp(-TE/T2); one echo leaves A and T2 unidentifiable
prior_art: Established identifiability and validation prerequisites, not a novel law
falsification: Acquire matched multi-echo measurements, noise model and pulse-sequence calibration. T1 effects require independent treatment.

claim: The MR and MG use distinct frames and only one CC projection is retained; no correspondence truth is supplied. A visually plausible warp is not validated anatomy.
prior_art: Established identifiability and validation prerequisites, not a novel law
falsification: Supply compression geometry, fiducials or adjudicated correspondences, plus independent registration checks.

claim: T2-weighted image intensity is sequence-dependent; no phantom, concentration assay, calibrated relaxation map or repeated acquisition is retained.
prior_art: Established identifiability and validation prerequisites, not a novel law
falsification: Add calibrated references and independent physical measurements; specify coil, sequence and noise dependencies.

claim: Seventy linked slices belong to one series and one patient. Slice interpolation tests image redundancy, not between-patient scientific validity.
prior_art: Established identifiability and validation prerequisites, not a novel law
falsification: Add independent patients or independent interventions/repeats with endpoints, and hold entire linked systems together.
